stages.headline: A prism is a polyhedron with two equal n-gon bases in parallel planes, and parallelogram lateral faces.
stages.headlineEnglish: A prism is a polyhedron with two equal n-gon bases in parallel planes, and parallelogram lateral faces.

stages.headline: If the lateral edges are perpendicular to the bases the prism is right, with rectangular lateral faces.
stages.headlineEnglish: If the lateral edges are perpendicular to the bases the prism is right, with rectangular lateral faces.

stages.headline: A cuboid is a quadrilateral prism.
